title: tissa glandulosa
intro: Tissa glandulosa, commonly known as Tissa's gland flower or Tissa's flower, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing stress, anxiety, and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Tissa glandulosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
